original: Hello, how can I help you today?
Hi, I was wondering what happens if I'm late paying my subscription fee?
Glad to help. May I have your name please?
thanks Alessandro. Give me a second.
Account has been pulled up for Alessandro Phoenix.
FAQ Answer selected: Late on a subscription payment.

If you're late on a subscription payment, your subscription benefits and ability to place new orders may be paused until the overdue balance is paid. However, depending on your membership level, you may be eligible for a payment extension or grace period if you reach out to us.
Got it, thanks! I was thinking of buying some things and wasn't sure if being late would stop me from ordering. I'm a gold member, by the way.

As a gold member, if you ever do fall behind on a subscription payment, you can contact us to arrange a payment extension so your account stays in good standing and you can keep ordering without interruption. You'll just want to make sure any past-due payment is either settled or extended before checking out.
That's really helpful to know, thanks!
You are welcome. Is there anything else that I can help you with?
